en: Hail to you in the victor’s wreath,
Feel in the splendour of the throne
like a rock in the sea.
May the deeds of warriors and heroes
Feel in the splendour of the throne
notes: The text is the version sung in the German Empire after 1871, addressed to the Emperor (Kaiser); Harries wrote for the King of Denmark in 1790 and Schumacher’s Prussian version of 1793 addressed the King.
Line 2.1: Reisige, mounted men-at-arms, an old word.
Line 4.1: Handlung, here trade or commerce.
